notes: The booklet is a low-resolution picture-only PDF with no inventory pages, so part identities (Element IDs) and colours are best-guess matches to the catalogue, not verified.

Page 2 shows a combination model that needs the separate set 8655 (red car) plus this set. Its parts are not in this set's inventory, so only the main 8658 Big Bling Wheelie (page 1, steps 1-9) is modelled.

To avoid reusing single-use ports, parts that carry several neighbours use catalogue types with several studs or anti-studs. The chassis plates b2 and b5 are 2x6 plates (lego-4211452), the rear plate b7 is a 2x4 plate (lego-302026), and the canopy b14 is a cab roof (lego-4193074, with two anti-studs). These are approximations of the pictured pieces.
Specific stud numbers are approximate, because the catalogue does not describe stud positions. Each port is used only once.
The grille/headlight piece (b10) is listed in step 6 (parts box item 2). It is attached at the front of the deck (b5).
The two exhausts (b11, b12) sit on the two hinge plates (b8, b9) at the rear.
The four wheels are modelled as lego-4624 (wheel with tyre) pushed onto the pins of the two wheel holders (b3, b4), as shown in step 9.
